name: invented1
idea: I exploit the 84-93% "delta-pair history" predictability (the pattern A→B followed by B→C implies A→D, i.e. `addr2 = addr0 + 2*stride`), which the single-step stride prefetcher cannot see. By keying a small per-PC state on the *previous* line, I predict the second-order continuation of a repeating stride pattern (common in the strided FFT/traversals and pointer-chain buffers) at low cost, covering
